title: A077754 — Murthy's conjecture: prescribed digit sums in residue classes (Lean 4)
description: Machine-checked proof of theorem A077754: for every n, there exists a multiple N of n with all-nonzero digits, digit sum n and at least 2 digits, iff n is not in {1,2,5,11} and not divisible by 10. Unconditional, proved for all n. Trust base: standard axioms (propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound) plus disclosed native_decide finite-certificate axioms (corner table, witSmall, residue_reach, stage_cover).
